about: Falloutak's item pictures (Marek 11-19: 'something resembling the item in inventory and hotbar'). slug = the item's custom-model-data string (Icons.slug in the plugin; 'kind/x' = a kind's picture where the item has none); items = the vanilla items whose definition the pack overrides (the vanilla model stays the fallback); prompt = what the picture was drawn from (FLUX.2 klein 4B on Cloudflare Workers AI, 512 px, reduced to 32 px by tools/pixelize.py). Our own pictures: free to publish.
style: Pixel art video game inventory icon of {thing}, one object centered and fully visible, bold dark outline, flat colours, plain pure white background, no text, no shadow
